code.description: Stable machine-readable code. New codes may be added; none is renamed.
Why nothing was done or it failed, e.g. `already_hidden`; null otherwise.

rotationOverlapUntil.description: While set and in the future, deliveries are signed with the previous secret too.

url.description: An `https://` URL on port 443 that resolves to public addresses only, at most 2048 characters.

eventTypes.description: The events this endpoint receives. At least one, without repeats.

secret.description: The signing secret. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.
